dedupe_keys.name: north east nigeria food assistance coverage and gap analysis april 2019 borno adamawa and yobe

description: This dataset records how far food assistance reached targeted people in the three crisis-affected states of north eastern Nigeria, Borno, Adamawa and Yobe, in April 2019. It was produced by iMMAP from the Food Security Sector's monthly monitoring of the response, which compares people targeted by key food assistance interventions with people actually reached, and was shared on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. The single zipped CSV file is very small and free to download without registration under a Creative Commons Attribution licence. Coverage is the three states for one month of the conflict-driven crisis in the Lake Chad basin. Caveats: it is a single month, the geographic level and the intervention categories must be read from the file, and coverage figures depend on partner reporting to the sector. Simulation uses: an observed gap between planned and delivered food assistance, useful for checking relief distribution and coverage models in conflict settings. Related records: the Cadre Harmonisé and IPC data for West and Central Africa (data-cadre-harmonise-west-central-africa) give the food insecurity needs behind the targets.
